text:
PERATURAN DAERAH KOTA BONTANG
NOMOR 9 TAHUN 2012
TENTANG
PERLINDUNGAN TERHADAP PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK KORBAN TINDAK  KEKERASAN
translated_text:
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BONTANG CITY
NUMBER 9 OF 2012
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

text:
WALIKOTA BONTANG
MEMUTUSKAN :
Menetapkan : PERATURAN DAERAH TENTANG PERLINDUNGAN  TERHADAP PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK KORBAN TINDAK  KEKERASAN .
translated_text:
MAYOR OF BONTANG
DECIDES:
To Establish: REGIONAL REGULATION ON PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE.

text:
BAB I
KETENTUAN UMUM
Pasal 1
Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:
1. Daerah adalah Kota Bontang.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Walikota dan perangkat daerah  sebagai unsur penyelenggara Pemerintah Daerah.
3. Kepala Daerah adalah Walikota Bontang.
4. Satuan Kerja Perangkat Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat  SKPD adalah Perangkat Daerah Pemerintah Kota Bontang.
5. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan  Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat P2TP2A adalah Unit Pelayanan Terpadu yang dibentuk oleh Pemerintah Daerah  untuk memberikan pelayanan kepada perempuan dan anak  korban tindak kekerasan secara komprehensif meliputi  pelayanan informasi, pendampingan dan bantuan hukum,  pelayanan konseling, pelayanan medis dan rumah aman  melalui rujukan.
6. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 tahun,  termasuk yang ada dalam kandungan.
7. Rumah Sakit Umum adalah tempat pelayanan yang  menyelenggarakan pelayanan medik dasar dan spesialistik, pelayanan penunjang medik, pelayanan instalasi dan  pelayanan perawatan secara rawat jalan dan rawat inap.
8. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat atau dapat mengakibatkan kesengsaraan atau penderitaan baik  fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial, psikis terhadap korban.
9. Korban adalah perempuan dan anak yang mengalami  kesengsaraan dan/atau penderitaan baik langsung maupun  tidak langsung sebagai akibat dari kekerasan.
10. Pelayanan adalah tindakan yang harus segera dilakukan  kepada korban ketika melihat, mendengar dan mengetahui akan, sedang atau telah terjadinya kekerasan terhadap  korban.
11. Pendamping adalah orang atau perwakilan dari lembaga yang mempunyai keahlian melakukan pendampingan korban  untuk melakukan konseling, terapi dan advokasi guna  memberikan penguatan dan pemulihan diri korban  kekerasan yang ditetapkan dalam suatu keputusan pejabat  yang berwenang.
12. Pendampingan adalah segala tindakan berupa konseling,  terapi psikologis, advokasi dan bimbingan rohani guna  penguatan diri korban kekerasan dalam rumah tangga untuk  menyelesaikan permasalahan yang dihadapi.
13. Pemulihan Korban adalah segala tindakan untuk penguatan  korban kekerasan dalam rumah tangga agar lebih berdaya,  secara fisik maupun psikis.
14. Penyelenggaraan Pemulihan adalah segala tindakan yang  meliputi pelayanan dan pendampingan kepada korban kekerasan dalam rumah tangga.
15. Kerjasama adalah cara yang sistematis dan terpadu antar  penyelenggara pemulihan dalam memberikan pelayanan  untuk memulihkan korban kekerasan dalam rumah tangga.
16. Rumah Aman adalah tempat tinggal sementara yang  digunakan untuk memberikan perlindungan terhadap  korban sesuai dengan standar operasional yang ditentukan.
17. Masyarakat adalah perseorangan keluarga, kelompok,  organisasi sosial dan atau organisasi kemasyarakatan.
18. Keluarga adalah unit terkecil dalam masyarakat yang  terdiri dari suami istri , atau suami istri dan anak-anaknya  atau ayah dan anaknya serta ibu dan anaknya atau  keluarga sedarah dalam garis lurus ke atas atau ke bawah  sampai dengan derajat ketiga.
19. Rumah Tangga adalah anggota keluarga dan kerabat (cucu,  kemenakan, kakak, adik, kakek, nenek, sepupu dan  sebagainya) dan bukan kerabat (pembantu, sopir dan  sebagainya) yang hidup dan makan dari satu dapur serta  menetap dalam satu rumah.
20. Lingkup Rumah Tangga adalah orang-orang yang  mempunyai hubungan keluarga dengan orang sebagaimana  dimaksud angka 19 karena hubungan darah, perkawinan,  persusuan, pengasuhan, perwalian yang menetap dalam  rumah tangga serta orang yang bekerja membantu rumah  tangga dan menetap dalam rumah tangga tersebut.
translated_text:
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Bontang.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor and regional apparatus as elements of the administration of the Regional Government.
3. Regional Head is the Mayor of Bontang.
4. Regional Apparatus Work Unit, hereinafter abbreviated as SKPD, is the Regional Apparatus of the Bontang City Government.
5. Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an Integrated Service Unit established by the Regional Government to provide services to women and children victims of violence comprehensively, including information services, accompaniment and legal aid, counseling services, medical services, and safe houses through referral.
6. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 years of age, including those in the womb.
7. General Hospital is a service facility that provides basic and specialist medical services, medical support services, hospital installation/unit services, and care services on an outpatient and inpatient basis.
8. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering, whether physical, sexual, economic, social, or psychological, to the victim.
9. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
10. Services are actions that must be immediately provided to the victim when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against the victim will occur, is occurring, or has occurred.
11. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to accompany victims to conduct counseling, therapy, and advocacy in order to provide strengthening and recovery of victims of violence, as stipulated in a decision of an authorized official.
12. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance for the self-strengthening of victims of domestic violence to resolve the problems faced.
13. Victim Recovery is all actions to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically.
14. Recovery Implementation is all actions that include services and assistance to victims of domestic violence.
15. Cooperation is a systematic and integrated method among recovery implementers in providing services to recover victims of domestic violence.
16. Safe House is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
17. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
18. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband, wife and their children, or father and his children and mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
19. Household is family members and relatives (grandchildren, nieces/nephews, older siblings, younger siblings, grandfathers, grandmothers, cousins and so forth) and non-relatives (domestic helpers, drivers and so forth) who live and eat from one kitchen and reside in one house.
20. Household Scope is people who have family relations with persons as referred to in number 19 due to blood relations, marriage, milk kinship, foster care, or guardianship who reside in the household, as well as people who work to assist the household and reside in that household.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/awkward rendering that changes legal sense: Item 10 translates 'Pelayanan' as 'Service' and uses ungrammatical phrasing ('taken to the victim'); should be 'Services'/'Service provision' and 'provided to the victim' while preserving the trigger conditions (seeing/hearing/knowing violence will, is, or has occurred).

Minor meaning/term accuracy: Item 7 'pelayanan instalasi' is rendered as 'installation services' (likely intended as 'inpatient unit/installation services' in hospital context); keep literal but clarify as 'hospital installation/unit services' to avoid misreading as construction/installation.

text:
Pasal 3
Tujuan perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban  tindak kekerasan adalah memberikan perlindungan dan  pelayanan untuk kepentingan yang terbaik bagi korban yang  terjadi di rumah tangga dan atau publik.
translated_text:
Article 3
The purpose of protection for women and children victims of acts of violence is to provide protection and services in the best interests of victims of acts of violence that occur in the household and/or in public.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/awkward clause attachment: "victims that occur" incorrectly modifies victims; should refer to acts/incidents occurring in the household and/or public.

text:
BAB III
BENTUK DAN LINGKUP TINDAK KEKERASAN
Bagian Kesatu
Bentuk Tindak Kekerasan
translated_text:
CHAPTER III
FORMS AND SCOPE OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE
Part One
Forms of Acts of Violence

qa_issues: Leftover untranslated heading: "Pasal 4" should be translated to "Article 4"
Meaning drift: "penelantaran rumah tangga" means "domestic household neglect/abandonment" (neglect within the household), not "domestic neglect"
Scrambled list structure: item d is merged into item c line instead of being a separate lettered item.

text:
Pasal 7
Kekerasan seksual sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 4 huruf c meliputi perbuatan yang berupa:
a. pelecehan seksual; dan/atau
b. pemaksaan hubungan seksual, dengan secara tidak wajar  atau tidak disukai oleh salah satu pihak, untuk tujuan  komersial dan atau tujuan tertentu.
translated_text:
Article 7
Sexual violence as referred to in Article 4 letter c includes acts in the form of:
a. sexual harassment; and/or
b. coercion of sexual relations, in an unnatural manner or not desired by one of the parties, for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
qa_issues: Leftover Indonesian heading term "Pasal 7" not translated to English.
Minor meaning/structure drift: "dan atau" should be rendered consistently as "and/or" (not "and or").

text:
Bagian Kedua
Lingkup Tindak Kekerasan
translated_text:
Second Part
Scope of Acts of Violence

text:
Pasal 9
(1) Lingkup tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak  meliputi:
a. tindak kekerasan yang terjadi di dalam rumah tangga; dan
b. tindak kekerasan yang terjadi di luar rumah tangga.
(2) Tindak kekerasan yang terjadi di dalam rumah tangga  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf a terjadi dalam  rumah tangga yang dilakukan oleh:
a. suami atau isteri di dalam perkawinan;
b. mempunyai hubungan keluarga sedarah, perkawinan,  adat, adopsi; atau
c. bekerja pada orang lain atau yang tinggal dan menetap  pada orang lain.
(3) Tindak kekerasan yang terjadi di luar rumah tangga  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf b terjadi di luar  rumah tangga meliputi:
a. pelecehan;
b. diskriminasi kekerasan di tempat kerja;
c. kekerasan di wilayah konflik;
d. kekerasan di media massa; dan
e. perdagangan orang.
translated_text:
Article 9
(1) The scope of acts of violence against women and children includes:
a. acts of violence that occur within the household; and
b. acts of violence that occur outside the household.
(2) Acts of violence that occur within the household as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a occur within the household committed by:
a. husband or wife within a marriage;
b. those having blood family relations, marriage, customary relations, adoption; or
c. those working for others or living and residing with others.
(3) Acts of violence that occur outside the household as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b occur outside the household including:
a. harassment;
b. violence discrimination in the workplace;
c. violence in conflict areas;
d. violence in mass media; and
e. human trafficking.
qa_issues: Meaning drift in Article 9(3)(b): original reads "diskriminasi kekerasan" (violence discrimination), but translation adds "and" ("discrimination and violence"), changing the construction/meaning.
Meaning drift/unnatural rendering in item c: "determination of their own decisions" does not accurately convey "menentukan sendiri keputusannya" (to decide for themselves).

Meaning drift/awkward rendering: "full use" does not reflect "penghormatan dan penggunaan sepenuhnya" in context; should convey full respect and fulfillment/implementation of rights for survival, growth and development.
Meaning drift/unnatural legal phrasing: "obtaining freedom" for item (e) should be rendered as "to obtain freedom" / "freedom" consistent with the Indonesian "mendapatkan kebebasan".

text:
BAB V
KEWAJIBAN DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB
Pasal 12
Kewajiban dan tanggung jawab dalam memberikan perlindungan  terhadap perempuan dan anak dari korban tindak kekerasan  merupakan tanggung jawab bersama:
a. Pemerintah Daerah;
b. Masyarakat; dan
c. Keluarga dan/atau orang tua.
translated_text:
CHAPTER V
OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Article 12
Obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children victims of acts of violence are the shared responsibility of:
a. Regional Government;
b. Community; and
c. Family and/or parents.

text:
Pasal 15
Kewajiban keluarga dan/atau orang tua sebagaimana dimaksud  dalam Pasal 6 huruf c, secara hukum memiliki tanggung jawab  penuh untuk mencegah segala bentuk tindak kekerasan dan  melindungi perempuan dan anak sebagai anggota keluarga.
translated_text:
Article 15
The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c, legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of acts of violence and protect women and children as family members.

qa_issues: Meaning drift: "penyuluhan" is better rendered as "outreach"/"education" rather than "counseling" (which overlaps with "bimbingan").
Meaning drift: "pos pengaduan" is a complaint post/complaints desk; "complaint posts" is awkward and may mislead—should be rendered as "complaints posts/desks" or "complaints centers".

text:
Pasal 17
Dalam melaksanakan upaya pencegahan tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak, Pemerintah Daerah harus  memperhatikan hak dan kewajiban orang tua, wali, suami atau  orang lain yang secara hukum bertanggungjawab terhadap  korban.
translated_text:
Article 17
In implementing efforts to prevent acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government must pay attention to the rights and obligations of parents, guardians, husbands or other persons who are legally responsible for the victim.

Lembaga Pelayanan

Service Institution

qa_issues: Meaning drift/grammar: paragraph (1) is an incomplete clause and omits the obligation/statement that the Regional Government provides protection services; needs a finite verb ("provides").

text:
Pasal 25
Pemerintah Daerah wajib memfasilitasi pemberian bantuan  hukum baik di dalam maupun di luar pengadilan, untuk  melakukan upaya hukum atas permintaan korban.
translated_text:
Article 25
The Regional Government is obligated to facilitate the provision of legal assistance both inside and outside the court, to undertake legal remedies at the request of victims.

qa_issues: Meaning drift: 'dapat diberitakan' is rendered as 'may be reported' (should be 'may be publicized/reported in the media')
Minor meaning/grammar drift: plural subject 'victim and/or companion' should take 'have given'

Meaning drift/awkward rendering in Article 28(3): Indonesian lists three service components (counseling, empowerment activities, and fostering victim self-reliance); current translation reads as if 'victim independence' is an object rather than a service component.
Meaning drift: 'pendamping' translated as 'companions' instead of 'assistants/companions (victim advocates/escorts)' in the legal context

text:
Bagian Ketiga
Mekanisme Pelayanan
translated_text:
Third Part
Service Mechanism

text:
Pasal 30
(1) Pelayanan terpadu terhadap perempuan dan anak korban  tindak kekerasan dilakukan atas:
a. inisiatif Pemerintah Daerah sendiri atau secara teknis oleh  SKPD terkait baik secara langsung maupun tidak langsung; atau
b. atas permintaan dan pengaduan korban, pemohon  pendamping keluarga, orang lain, organisasi masyarakat, organisasi sosial atau lembaga swadaya masyarakat yang mengetahui.
(2) Pelayanan terpadu yang dilakukan oleh P2TP2A dilakukan  berdasarkan rujukan dari lembaga pelayanan atau  berdasarkan pengaduan korban maupun keluarganya;
(3) Ketentuan mengenai tata cara dan prosedur mendapatkan  pelayanan P2TP2A dalam Peraturan Walikota.
translated_text:
Article 30
(1) Integrated services for women and children victims of acts of violence are carried out based on:
a. the initiative of the Regional Government itself or, technically, by the relevant SKPD either directly or indirectly; or
b. upon the request and complaint of the victim, an applicant for family assistance/companion services, family companion, other persons, community organizations, social organizations, or non-governmental organizations that know/are aware of the incident.
(2) Integrated services carried out by P2TP2A are conducted based on referrals from service institutions or based on complaints from victims or their families;
(3) Provisions regarding the procedures and processes for obtaining P2TP2A services are regulated in the Mayor's Regulation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/awkward rendering in item (1)(b): "who have knowledge" does not clearly convey "yang mengetahui" (who know/are aware of the incident) and "applicant family companion" is unclear for "pemohon pendamping keluarga".

Minor meaning drift in (3): Indonesian states the provisions are regulated in a Mayor Regulation; translation adds "are set forth" but acceptable—however "procedures and procedures" duplicates "tata cara dan prosedur" and should be rendered as "procedures and processes" or similar to preserve distinct terms.
Meaning drift/unnatural term in (2): "medical psychology" should reflect "psychological and medical services" (layanan psikologis medis).

text:
BAB IX
PELAKSANAAN PENDAMPINGAN
Pasal 32
(1) Pendampingan dilakukan oleh orang atau lembaga yang  mempunyai keahlian untuk melakukan konseling, terapi,  dan advokasi guna penguatan dan pemulihan korban  kekerasan;
(2) Pendampingan yang dilakukan oleh orang atau lembaga  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) harus berkoordinasi dengan P2TP2A.
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX
IMPLEMENTATION OF ASSISTANCE
Article 32
(1) Assistance shall be carried out by persons or institutions that have the expertise to conduct counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence;
(2) Assistance carried out by persons or institutions as referred to in paragraph (1) must coordinate with P2TP2A.

text:
BAB X
PENANGANAN TERHADAP ANAK YANG BERHADAPAN DENGAN HUKUM
Pasal 33
Penanganan anak yang berhadapan dengan hukum meliputi:  a. anak sebagai pelaku;
b. anak sebagai korban; dan
c. anak sebagai saksi tindak pidana.
translated_text:
CHAPTER X
HANDLING OF CHILDREN IN CONFLICT WITH THE LAW
Article 33
Handling of children in conflict with the law includes: a. children as perpetrators;
b. children as victims; and
c. children as witnesses of criminal acts.

qa_issues: Meaning drift: "penyerahan berkas perkara" in item d is translated as "submission"; more accurate is "handover/transfer" of case files to the Public Prosecutor.
Meaning drift: item e "melimpahkan berkas perkara" is translated as "submit"; more accurate is "transfer/forward" the case files to the District Court. (Keep legal sense of case-file transfer).

Meaning drift: 'pendamping' in item g is rendered as 'an accompanying person' instead of the intended 'assistance/companion (support person)' and should be expressed as being provided with accompaniment/assistance throughout the process.

text:
BAB XII
PENDANAAN
Pasal 39
(1) Dana penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dan anak  korban tindak kekerasan yang dikelola oleh P2TP2A wajib  dialokasikan pada Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja  Daerah;
(2) Selain sumber anggaran sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat  (1) dana penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dan anak  korban tindak kekerasan dapat juga bersumber dari  anggaran lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XII
FUNDING
Article 39
(1) Funds for the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence managed by P2TP2A must be allocated in the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget;
(2) In addition to the budget source as referred to in paragraph (1), funds for the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence may also be sourced from other legitimate and non-binding budgets.

text:
Pasal 42
Masyarakat dapat melakukan pengawasan penyelenggaraan  perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban tindak kekerasan  yang diselenggarakan oleh Pemerintah Daerah.
translated_text:
Article 42
The community may conduct supervision of the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence organized by the Regional Government.

text:
BAB XIV
PENUTUP
Pasal 43
Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal diundangkan.
Agar setiap orang mengetahuinya, memerintahkan  pengundangan Peraturan Daerah ini dengan penempatannya  dalam lembaran daerah Ditetapkan di Bontang pada tanggal 28 Juni 2012
translated_text:
CHAPTER XIV
CLOSING PROVISIONS
Article 43
This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of its promulgation.
In order that everyone may know of it, it is ordered that this Regional Regulation be promulgated by placing it in the Regional Gazette.
Enacted in Bontang on 28 June 2012
qa_issues: Meaning drift/omission: missing the phrase indicating placement in the Regional Gazette/Regional Sheet as a distinct clause and missing punctuation/structure separating the promulgation order from the enactment statement.
Scrambled/merged structure: the sentence about promulgation and the enactment line are run together; needs separation to reflect the original legal formatting.
